summary: Iteration 3 tested end-to-end: change-password (backend + admin modal), Open-Meteo weather card on planning day view, week view with 7 day cards + navigation, landing scroll-to-top button, and Outfit numeric font. All 37 backend tests pass (12 new + 25 regression). All 5 frontend flows pass. Admin password restored to 'admin' via pymongo direct DB update after the destructive change test.

issues: When Open-Meteo returns 502 (dates outside its forecast horizon e.g. 2026-03-15 today), the entire raw Cloudflare HTML error text is dumped into [data-testid=weather-spot] as if it were a spot name. Expected: show a graceful fallback (e.g. 'Prévisions indisponibles pour cette date') and keep the section collapsed. The .catch() sets `error` from `e?.response?.data?.detail` which is the whole HTML string when the upstream is not JSON.

action_items: Weather error handling: sanitize non-JSON upstream errors in WeatherCard so a 502 from Open-Meteo doesn't render Cloudflare HTML into the spot name. Consider catching non-2xx early in backend get_weather and returning a friendly {detail: 'Météo indisponible pour cette date'} of ≤120 chars.

Hydration warning in dev only: Emergent's <option> instrumentation injects a <span> child which triggers a React 'span cannot be a child of option' console error on the planning page (assign-slot select). Not a real bug — cosmetic dev-only warning caused by x-ve-dynamic instrumentation, not by AdminPlanning.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/weather.py raises HTTPException(502, e.response.text) implicitly via _fetch — but FastAPI receives an HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=<string>) which serializes fine. When Open-Meteo itself proxies to Cloudflare and returns HTML, the entire HTML doc becomes the detail. Truncate or replace with a generic message.

auth.py change_password: 'same as current' check runs AFTER hashing check — good, but note Pydantic min_length=8 catches new<8 at validation (422) so the 400 branch inside change_password is unreachable for that case (test expects 422). No bug, just doc mismatch with the review request that said 'new < 8 chars → 422'.
stats.compute_week: `used` is clamped to capacity before computing occupancy, but occupancy is computed from the *unclamped* `used`. Verified acceptable (min(used/capacity,1) rounds to 0-100).
WeatherCard 502 error path renders unsafely — see design_issues above.

rca_of_the_issue: Weather 502 display bug: /app/frontend/src/components/admin/WeatherCard.jsx line 38 `setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Météo indisponible')`. When Open-Meteo upstream returns 502 with HTML body, backend httpx raises HTTPStatusError and weather.py _fetch re-raises HTTPException(502, f'Météo indisponible (HTTP 502)') — that's actually fine. The failure I observed came from k8s ingress/Cloudflare wrapping the 502 with a full HTML error page before it reaches the client, so response.data ends up being the HTML string. Mitigation: in WeatherCard, if detail length > 120 or contains '<', fall back to a hard-coded 'Météo indisponible pour cette date.' Reproduction: GET /api/admin/weather?day=2026-03-15 (>6 months out) with admin token; observe the frontend renders the HTML in weather-spot. Verified in test_weather_past_date_acceptable which accepts 200/502/504.
